description: This file defines the Tracking controller class within the Opencart project's catalog module. It primarily handles user tracking and affiliate link management within the account section, including displaying tracking info and providing an autocomplete feature for products.

classes.name: Tracking
classes.description: Controller class for handling user tracking and affiliate link management within the account section of the Opencart website.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the tracking page, ensuring user authentication, retrieving affiliate information, and preparing data for view rendering.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests for product autocomplete suggestions based on user input and tracking code.
